# Mentorink

> AI-powered mentoring software platform designed to streamline workplace mentorship, talent development, and leadership growth with seamless HRIS and LMS integration.

Mentorink serves enterprise organizations including Siemens, L'Oréal, Mercedes-Benz, and Société Générale with comprehensive mentoring solutions. The platform combines intelligent matching algorithms, security compliance (GDPR, SOC2), and flexible deployment options to support diverse mentoring models from one-on-one career guidance to group learning initiatives.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered mentoring
- Leadership development
- Talent development
- HRIS integration
- LMS integration
- Employee retention
- Mentorship programs
- Smart matching
- Data security (GDPR, SOC2)
- White-label solutions
- SSO authentication
- Professional development
- Workplace culture
- Succession planning
- Employee onboarding
